title: Vaccine analysis workspace
summary: Configure and run descriptive vaccine immunogenicity and solicited-reactogenicity analyses directly in this browser. Upload CSVs or deliberately load the synthetic example, map columns, review study-specific assumptions, and run the same R analysis functions used by the desktop toolkit. No R installation, account or toolkit download is needed.
data_scope: Your CSVs or a synthetic example
data_note: The initial workspace is blank. Example participants and study settings are fictional; your uploaded inputs are used only in this browser session.
usage_note: Use Load synthetic example to explore, or upload your study CSVs. Review the settings and confirmations before running. Download results to keep them; reloading clears the session.
try: Choose Load synthetic example, then inspect the uploaded populations, assay results, administered doses and diaries. The example includes quantification limits and missing observations.
Review the assay/visit and diary definitions, confirm the study assumptions and run all six selected outputs. Study-defined response thresholds do not establish protection.

Compare the geometric summaries, paired fold rises, responder counts and diary completeness. Download the complete report ZIP, individual tables or figures, configured SAS reference and reusable setup profile.
Change an input or setting to see prior results become unavailable until you validate and run again. Reset clears the workspace.

interactions.name: A blank client-neutral workspace requires deliberate setup
Synthetic example runs all six reviewed R outputs in the browser
